evidence: Films were deposited and in situ analyzed by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) to evaluate growth kinetics, interfacial chemistry with the substrate, and film composition. ... The XPS data were acquired on a PHI 3057 spectrometer ... Thick films deposited under CVD conditions were also characterized by cross-sectional scanning electron microscopy (SEM) using a LEO 1530 system and by four-point probe resistivity analysis.
